dialogues.speaker: Chihu Rock Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Liyue branch of the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: When gazing at the night sky, do you find yourself yearning to reach the stars?

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: When overlooking a perilous abyss, do you find yourself wondering what treasure lies at the bottom?

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: Sign up for the Adventurers' Guild! Let's conquer all the world's dangers and uncover all the world's secrets together.

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: Please talk to Katheryne for more information.
